issue_context.title: The parser does not throw an error for a namespace export with a named export
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

Named export is not supposed to be worked with export namespaced at the same time.
[Rollup Repl](https://rollupjs.org/repl/?version=2.70.2&)

### Input code

```typescript
export * as foo, { bar } from "./foo"
```


### Config

```json
{
  "jsc": {
    "parser": {
      "syntax": "typescript",
      "tsx": false
    },
    "target": "es2022",
    "loose": false,
    "minify": {
      "compress": false,
      "mangle": false
    }
  },
  "module": {
    "type": "commonjs"
  },
  "minify": false,
  "isModule": true
}
```


### Playground link

https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.2.157&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0utKMgvKlFISU3OSSxKVUgrzUsuyczPU0jLz7ex00i0UgjRtFIoy89MsebiSoWo1VJILAbJ6yhUK5SkFpco1CqkFeXnKijp6ScWp6QpAQCCetchUwAAAA%3D%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA0WNSwrDMAxE76J1FsXL3KGHMK4SHOIPGgdqjO9euThkJ2nePDU64GhtlK2AZUyosdgvrVRqZjjxudBCBXra7AnuuljZuSjCMC9jND5TAk9goeCj3%2BqQuRSyMPBENu7nTXZ1hfS5xqH9%2F6lTKyHFA9Qf0Sx7vCdd5OL%2BAwzZOlG9AAAA

### Expected behavior

Throw an syntax error.

### Actual behavior

Successfully parsed

### Version

1.2.157

### Additional context

_No response_

review_comments: @kdy1 check this one. Is this wrong test case?
I think this should panic (with tested error message)?

Is there any spec of compound rules?
It's a little weird if we allow issue_4369_2, issue_4369_3, issue_4369_5 but disallow issue_4369_4.

I expects the default/namespace/name could be compounded arbitrarily if [export default from](https://github.com/tc39/proposal-export-default-from) proposal is accepted.
But this is a namespace export with a named export, which is #4369 about
I think this is not allowed at the moment, and I'm not sure if the proposal for `export default from` wil touch this one
